name: colorWave
description: The viewer's color wave, as on the blog: two interfering waves in distance from the viewer's origin, times exp(-0.01 r^2), recolor splats by the direction to them (abs of the unit vector), fade their opacity with the wave, and nudge them by 0.02.

source.name: World Labs threeviewer effects (newEffects.glsl colorWave, pixelWorld + vertexWorld), blog demo parameters
